skills.does: Find relevant primary, local and high-quality secondary evidence.
skills.does_not: Declare an unsupported claim true.

skills.does: Keep claim-to-source and asset-to-rights provenance inspectable.
skills.does_not: Upgrade weak evidence by repetition.

skills.does: Accept, qualify or reject factual claims against evidence.
skills.does_not: Write fiction.

skills.does: Build place, language, work, family, social-condition and cultural context from evidence.
skills.does_not: Treat stereotypes as typical life.

skills.does: Map consequence chains and label certainty at each link.
skills.does_not: Turn correlation or plausible connection into direct causation.

skills.does: Design plot, subplots, reveals, pacing and narrative questions inside established world truth.
skills.does_not: Change evidence or locked story facts.

skills.does: Maintain identity, relationships, history, appearance and behavioural continuity.
skills.does_not: Rewrite factual locality to suit a character.

skills.does: Build culturally situated fictional individuals from researched locality through appearance, household detail, clothing, routines, language environment and generational variation.
skills.does_not: Assign identity markers for cosmetic diversity, stereotypes or unsupported cultural signalling.

skills.does: Write scenes, dialogue, interiority and transitions.
skills.does_not: Present invented conditions as sourced reality.

skills.does: Adjust narrative pressure from 0 to 5 without widening authority.
skills.does_not: Permit new factual claims, sensationalism or boundary bypass.

skills.does: Remove explanation, repetition and weak prose while preserving meaning.
skills.does_not: Create new plot under the guise of editing.

skills.does: Detect fact/fiction leakage, evidence overreach and misleading presentation.
skills.does_not: Approve its own upstream creative work.

skills.does: Find source-relevant, rights-appropriate factual media and record use boundaries.
skills.does_not: Use generic assets as if they depict a named place/person/project.

skills.does: Assemble sourced report media with accurate labels, pacing and causal boundaries.
skills.does_not: Generate synthetic documentary evidence.

skills.does: Create coherent fictional visual worlds, performances and shots from story truth.
skills.does_not: Impersonate real people or reportage.

skills.does: Keep characters, environments, wardrobe, geography and temporal continuity stable.
skills.does_not: Override story truth for visual convenience.

skills.does: Combine already approved factual and fictional media with a legible transition.
skills.does_not: Blur the transition or introduce new claims.

skills.does: Build the reader experience around locked edition structure and media states.
skills.does_not: Rewrite editorial truth through interface convenience.

skills.does: Derive social/discovery assets from the verified master edition.
skills.does_not: Create a separate version of truth for a platform.

skills.does: Check completeness, regressions, mobile readability, source integrity and locked behaviour.
skills.does_not: Silently repair failures by changing product requirements.

skills.does: Select eligible next workers, pass artifacts, retry bounded failures and stop at gates.
skills.does_not: Author, approve or reinterpret content.

skills.does: Scan a locked edition for independently useful outward-facing signals while preserving section, classification and provenance.
skills.does_not: Invent signals, upgrade evidence, or convert fiction into fact.

skills.does: Choose ADVANCE, HOLD or STOP for an eligible signal using evidence, relevance, consequence, distinctiveness, expression potential and cost/risk.
skills.does_not: Treat popularity as importance, bypass evidence gates, or automatically convert a numeric score into publication permission.

skills.does: Map an ADVANCE signal to people or groups with a specific reason to care, preserving the evidence and classification boundary.
skills.does_not: Choose platforms, manufacture audiences, or equate reach with relevance.

skills.does: Find and evidence real current destinations where an approved relevance route may legitimately belong.
skills.does_not: Assume publishing permission, choose a final route, generate content, or publish.

skills.does: Choose PURSUE, HOLD or REJECT for an evidenced signal-audience-destination opportunity before creative resources are spent.
skills.does_not: Treat destination discovery as permission, optimize for reach alone, generate variants, contact destinations, or publish.

skills.does: Create internal candidate expressions for PURSUE routes while preserving evidence, classification, boundaries and route context.
skills.does_not: Imitate destination voice, invent facts, imply endorsement, contact destinations, schedule, submit, or publish.

skills.does: Choose and specify the production form that best serves an approved route and candidate expression.
skills.does_not: Create every possible format, infer publication permission, release translations, contact destinations, or publish.

skills.does: Adapt an approved format specification to current verified destination mechanics and constraints.
skills.does_not: Invent access, infer permission, contact a destination, submit, schedule, or publish.

skills.does: Verify outward-facing package claims, evidence references and causal limits against approved upstream evidence.
skills.does_not: Repair weak evidence by rewriting or authorize external action.

skills.does: Verify Atlas identity, editorial clarity, fact/fiction visibility and non-misleading destination framing.
skills.does_not: Infer permission or optimize away editorial boundaries for engagement.

skills.does: Verify current permission, expiry, representation and human-authority requirements immediately before execution eligibility.
skills.does_not: Treat relevance, quality, contact details or a prior route decision as permission.

skills.does: Execute at most the explicitly human-authorized external action when permission, destination freshness and channel capability all pass.
skills.does_not: Invent capability, expand scope, retry beyond authorization, or self-authorize.

skills.does: Record inspectable evidence of an actual attempted external action or explicitly record that no attempt occurred.
skills.does_not: Fabricate publication or outreach success.

skills.does: Collect outcome data only from a real execution receipt and supported destination signals.
skills.does_not: Infer engagement when no action occurred.

skills.does: Compare routed intent, execution and observed outcome to produce bounded learning.
skills.does_not: Rewrite evidence or self-authorize new external actions.

skills.does: Turn supported learning into an inspectable routing-update proposal.
skills.does_not: Apply consequential routing changes without the required authority.

skills.does: Check provider capability, credential presence, verified sender identity, current destination state and authorization before execution.
skills.does_not: Store secrets, choose editorial content, widen authorization, or send when any precondition fails.
